cards.english: Your package arrived.
Take your things.
Respect your parents.
Tea or coffee?
This is my window.
Is this your backpack?
Is this your pen?
Our assignment is difficult.
Our neighbors are kind.
Your opinion is important.
Whose umbrella is this?
Whose bag is this?
Whose coat is this?
Whose decision is this?
It's three o'clock.
Remember your promises.
Watch your health.
See you tomorrow!
He loves his job.
My parents are retired.
She found her keys.
They remember their youth.
His work is very important.
Her cat is very beautiful.
Our city is very beautiful.
My parents like to travel.
We are proud of our city.
In the morning I drink coffee.
We miss our home.
My favorite color is blue.
His favorite hobby is reading.
This is what I need.
His car is in the yard.
His parents live in the village.
Her husband works at a bank.
Our neighbors have a beautiful garden.
He doesn't know where to go.
His job takes a lot of time.
The people who live here are friendly.
The dog whose owner left is whining.
He forgot what he wanted to say.
He called to find out the news.
We'll be back by six.
A little boy is playing with a ball.
The student who passed the exam is happy.
The girl whose eyes are blue is smiling.
We hurried so as not to be late.
Tell me, please, what time is it now?
My favorite season is summer.

cards.target: Ни он, ни она не знали.
cards.english: Neither he nor she knew.

cards.target: Вместо того чтобы отдыхать, он работал.
cards.english: Instead of resting, he worked.
cards.existing: `Чтобы` (Chtoby) always introduces purpose or desire. After verbs of wanting/asking/ordering with a different subject in the subordinate clause, it's required.

cards.target: Я звонил, а никто не ответил.
cards.english: I called, but nobody answered.

cards.target: Это именно то, что мне нужно.
cards.english: This is exactly what I need.

cards.target: Библиотека, в которую я хожу, большая.
cards.english: The library I go to is big.

cards.target: Их любимая песня звучит по радио.
cards.english: Their favorite song is playing on the radio.

cards.target: Дом, в котором мы живём, старый.
cards.english: The house in which we live is old.
The girl who is singing is my sister.

cards.target: Парк, в котором мы гуляли, большой.
cards.english: The park in which we walked is big.

cards.target: Озеро, около которого мы жили, чистое.
cards.english: The lake near which we lived is clean.
cards.existing: Put a comma before `который` (Russian punctuation rule). The clause is set off by commas on both sides if it's in the middle.

cards.target: Улица, на которой я живу, тихая.
cards.english: The street on which I live is quiet.

cards.target: Вот книга, о которой я говорил.
cards.english: Here is the book I was talking about.

cards.target: Мне рассказали историю, которая меня удивила.
cards.english: I was told a story that surprised me.

cards.target: Мы поедем, если будет хорошая погода.
cards.english: We will go if the weather is good.
cards.existing: Unlike English ('if it rains' – present), Russian uses future in both clauses for real future conditions.

cards.target: Рано утром мы вышли из дома.
cards.english: Early in the morning we left the house.

cards.target: Он всегда носит с собой свой зонт.
cards.english: He always carries his umbrella with him.

cards.target: Я не понимаю, о чём вы говорите.
cards.english: I don't understand what you are talking about.

cards.target: Человек, который стоит там, – мой друг.
cards.english: The person who is standing there is my friend.

cards.target: Мало того что опоздал, ещё и забыл документы.
cards.english: Not only did someone arrive late, but they also forgot their documents.
Their dog barks loudly.
I am proud of my achievements.
She is satisfied with her job.
He takes care of his health.
They are confident in their abilities.
At whose house are you standing?
His apartment is on the fifth floor.
There are many parks in my city.
Whose car is parked at the entrance?
The dog that barks does not bite.
There are things that cannot be forgotten.
The city where I was born is small.
Their house is on the outskirts of the city.

cards.target: Не забывай тех, кто тебе помог.
cards.english: Don't forget those who helped you.

cards.target: Врач, к которому я хожу, опытный.
cards.english: The doctor I go to is experienced.

cards.target: Страна, в которой мы отдыхали, красивая.
cards.english: The country where we vacationed is beautiful.

cards.target: Дорога, по которой мы ехали, плохая.
cards.english: The road we drove on is bad.

cards.target: Я проснулся, потому что было шумно.
cards.english: I woke up because it was noisy.

cards.target: Она говорила так, словно знала всё.
cards.english: She spoke as if she knew everything.

cards.target: Тема, о которой мы говорили, интересная.
cards.english: The topic we were talking about is interesting.

cards.target: Учитель сказал, чтобы мы открыли книги.
cards.english: The teacher told us to open the books.
cards.existing: Don't confuse `чтобы` (purpose/desire) with `что` (statement). `Я знаю, что он пришёл` (I know that he came – fact) vs `я хочу, чтобы он пришёл` (I want him to come – wish).

cards.target: Картина, которая висит на стене, красивая.
cards.english: The painting that hangs on the wall is beautiful.

cards.target: По вечерам учитель рисует в студии.
cards.english: In the evenings the teacher paints in the studio.

cards.target: Окно, которое я открыл, выходит в сад.
cards.english: The window that I opened faces the garden.

cards.target: Школа, в которой я учился, далеко отсюда.
cards.english: The school I studied at is far from here.

cards.target: Человек, чей дом горит, звонит в пожарную.
cards.english: The person whose house is burning is calling the fire department.

cards.target: Друг, с которым я учился, живёт за границей.
cards.english: The friend with whom I studied lives abroad.

cards.target: Человек, у которого я спросил дорогу, помог мне.
cards.english: The person I asked for directions helped me.

cards.target: Они горды тем, что их сын стал врачом.
cards.english: They are proud that their son became a doctor.

cards.target: Либо мы идём сейчас, либо не идём вообще.
cards.english: Either we go now or we don't go at all.

cards.target: Туман густо окутал луга и поля ранним утром.
cards.english: Fog enveloped the meadows and fields early in the morning.

cards.target: Паркетчик уложил дубовые доски в большом банкетном зале.
cards.english: The floor layer installed oak planks in the large banquet hall.
Are these your glasses?
Whose gloves are these?
We are satisfied with our result.
My favorite flowers are roses.
Her favorite subject is math.
The event after which everything changed.
While we were driving, it was snowing.

cards.target: Институт, в котором она учится, престижный.
cards.english: The institute where she studies is prestigious.
